title: Centella asiatica tea for medicinal use
intro: Centella asiatica tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the Centella asiatica plant, also known as gotu kola. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine for its purported ability to enhance cognitive function and promote skin health. The tea is often consumed to support mental clarity, reduce anxiety, and improve circulation. It is also believed to aid in the healing of wounds and the reduction of inflammation. In herbalism, it is commonly used as a calming tonic and for its potential benefits in stress relief and overall well-being.
